firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 8 words / 2 lines with trade + city + outcome, one primary (Price my cleaning) plus a quieter call button, Sample-labelled proof line, brass band peeks ~64px, Season Dial in the hero. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above the fold. Capped by mustFix: 1024-first.jpg dial labels collide ('WINTER · CABINSSPRING · POLLEN', 'GUESTS SUMMER'); 1440-first.jpg 'EDITION' and 'WINTER · CABINS' gold mono labels sink into the bright fog.

distinctiveness.notes: 1440-full.jpg: the Season Dial now does work in the hero, the almanac index (quarter icons), every spread dateline, the sticky top-right dial that reads SUMMER / WINTER (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg), the countdown ring, the reviews header and the footer 'Back to spring'. Held back by template sections: 01-09 numbered 3x3 services grid with 'Get a price ->' on every card and a 3x2 review card grid (1440-scroll-75.jpg) (-0.5).

type.notes: 1440-first.jpg: tight high-contrast display serif with real scale contrast; curly quotes and en-dash ranges now correct (1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-full.jpg). 1440-first.jpg: hero eyebrow + four dial labels + mono proof line = 6 tracked mono caps strings in one view (-0.5).

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: real tonal rhythm deep / brass / paper / slate / full-bleed photo break / paper / deep / paper / white / deep / paper / deep, no two darks touching; break band 'Same house. Four different messes a year.' lands. 1440-full.jpg pollen spread: the white price chip is narrower than its text, '(porches, screens, fans)' runs off the box (-0.5); winter spread leaves a dead block under the h2 (1440-scroll-50.jpg).

photo.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: real photos now, hero fog is strong and on-concept. Spring figure is a saturated emerald cloth that reads as fabric, not pollen or a porch, and clashes with the brass/charcoal grade (-0.5 mixed grade, -0.5 weak topic fit); 1440-scroll-25.jpg shower frame shows a white sliver along its right edge; cabin bath (1440-scroll-50.jpg) is a flash snapshot, warm and flat next to the cool shower.

copy.notes: 1440-scroll-75.jpg: reviews are concrete and local (heart pine, porch turns yellow, fan on), Sample labels everywhere, tool microcopy good (1440-scroll-50.jpg). Primary action has four names: 'Price my cleaning' (1440-first.jpg), 'Get a price' (390-first.jpg bar, services), 'Book a visit' (header), 'Price a mildew clean' (-0.5).

mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above fold, sticky Call / Get a price bar; render.json no overflow at 320/390. 390-full.jpg: spreads stack image-then-text and the countdown is thumb-usable, but sections are collapsed desktop, not re-cut (hero same crop, services 9 stacked rows).

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg / 390-rm-full.jpg: every word visible in reduced motion. mustFix: 1440-first.jpg dial labels (#B8945F mono on light fog) and 390-first.jpg eyebrow 'THE HOUSE ALMANAC' over the bright fog are under 4.5:1.

motion.notes: 1440-scroll-25.jpg / 1440-scroll-50.jpg: the sticky dial turns and relabels SUMMER -> WINTER through the spreads, the motion idea now exists; countdown ring draws its arc (1440-scroll-50.jpg). The hero dial is a single arc, not the four-segment fill promised, and no other entrance language is visible beyond reveals.

wow.notes: 1440-full.jpg / 390-full.jpg: countdown tool answers in the dial's language (20 DAYS OUT ring with book-by / deep-clean / touch-up ticks + dated list). Tied to the thesis, but it covers only fall; no keepable output (print/save) and the season planner promised in concept.json is not visible.

polish.notes: 1440-full.jpg footer is a designed close with the dial and credits. Deductions: 1024-first.jpg label collision; pollen price chip overflow (1440-full.jpg); white sliver on the shower frame (1440-scroll-25.jpg); 'Get a price ->' arrow on 9 links (1440-scroll-75.jpg).

mustFix.problem: Quarter labels overlap at 1024: 'WINTER · CABINSSPRING · POLLEN' and 'FALL · GUESTS SUMMER · MILDEW' run together
mustFix.fix: Below 1100px drop the 'season · word' labels to the season name only, or stack them in a 2x2 grid under the dial with a 16px gap; at <900px hide them

mustFix.where: 1440-first.jpg, 390-first.jpg: hero dial labels, 'EDITION', eyebrow 'RIVERFOG · THE HOUSE ALMANAC'
mustFix.problem: Gold mono text sits on the brightest part of the fog photo, well under 4.5:1
mustFix.fix: Set these labels to --paper (#F3EFE6) or add a local scrim (radial rgba(20,25,22,.55) behind the dial and a left-to-right gradient behind the hero text column) so each label measures >= 4.5:1

elevate.move: Grade the whole set as one almanac shoot: a single warm-charcoal duotone-leaning grade (lifted blacks, brass highlights) across all frames, replace the green cloth with a pollen-season porch/screen frame, and give each spread figure the dial's quarter-circle crop corner so the photos sit inside the signature

Make the hero dial the masthead: a true four-segment brass dial with the current season filled and its label set in paper on a fog scrim, so the first screen reads as the almanac cover and hands off to the sticky dial on scroll
